maria.product: Heads-up from sales: BigCorp wants a guaranteed pin for a model during their pilot, but they also asked for our performance SLA. We need a short proposal that balances customer lock-in risk vs engineering burden.
sam.eng: I propose a 'pin delta' approach: allow pin for 90 days but require the model passes a 'pin stability suite' nightly. If nightly fails twice in 7 days, we auto-open a support ticket and propose a migration window.
jeff.sales: BigCorp will accept 90 days if we provide a clear rollback plan and at least one fallback model that's within X% of quality. They also want the deprecation notice to be 60 days min.
anna.solutions: Customer asked to be in the canary cohort and to see the CI bench outputs for their pinned model. We should plan to grant read-only access to a canary dashboard.
ci-bot: grant:canary-dashboard scheduled 4370011700
maria.product: Action items: (1) Product to draft 'pin delta' policy language and read-only dashboard access flow. (2) Eng to add pin stability checks to nightly. (3) Sales to confirm BigCorp in canary. We'll post drafts by EOD Wednesday.
